method.ratings: Career-mode base FC/FIFA ratings; editions kept separate in match records; no FUT upgrades.
method.ratingSnapshot: Source as-of date and conservative release availability; no later ratings substituted.
method.actualXI: Exactly 11 unique matched starters per side, otherwise missing; never fill missing players with a club average.
method.teamOVR: Published team OVR is a proxy, not the actual starting XI mean; panels never mix the two.
method.lineupNames: Unique exact full/short name preferred within club, then globally; unique initial+surname fallback recorded explicitly, never fuzzy similarity.
method.missing: Missing metric remains missing, never zero; each metric reports n.
method.extraTime: Extra-time aggregate cup boxes excluded; FA penalty finals excluded. League totals are regulation plus added time.
method.strong: Higher FC score, home side used for exact ties and counted explicitly.
method.headBottom: Retrospective final points/GD/GF order, top and bottom floor(N/5); descriptive label, not a pre-match predictor or official H2H tie-break.
method.FM: Separate archived community FM rating cross-check, not mixed with FC OVR or claimed to be raw CA/2.
method.limits: Observed outcomes conditional on ratings, not a causal tactical effect or mandatory per-match limits.

fmCrosscheck.caveat: Not raw CA; aggregation formula and original database patch date unavailable. Used only for independent ordinal context, not a pre-match dated causal model or CA/2.
fmCrosscheck.scope: Ordinal cross-check only. Community formula and original FM24 patch date unknown; never a dated pre-match CA estimate or numerical conversion into FC.
